title: A Border for the Contact
author: Cyrus Yarrow
blurb: Wendell Underhill, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
